title: How Much Does AppsFlyer Cost for a Small Subscription App? — Airbridge

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Growth plan charges $0.07 per attributed conversion after the Welcome Package, according to the Airbridge blog's reading of AppsFlyer's pricing page.
facts.quote: AppsFlyer's Growth plan charges $0.07 per attributed conversion after a Welcome Package of 12,000 free conversions in the first 12 months.

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Zero plan includes a Welcome Package of 12,000 free conversions to use within the first 12 months.
facts.quote: Includes the Welcome Package: 12,000 free conversions to use within the first 12 months

facts.fact: AppsFlyer describes its Zero plan as for apps using owned media and as not suitable for apps with paid activities.
facts.quote: "not suitable for apps with paid activities"

facts.fact: According to the page, AppsFlyer does not count organic installs as conversions and they are free.
facts.quote: Organic installs are not counted and are free

facts.fact: AppsFlyer counts attributed installs, re-engagements, and re-attributions as billable conversions.
The AppsFlyer Welcome Package includes a 30-day trial of select premium add-ons.
facts.quote: The Welcome Package includes a 30-day trial of select premium add-ons

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Enterprise plan uses custom pricing negotiated through its sales team.
facts.quote: Custom pricing through AppsFlyer's sales team

facts.fact: AppsFlyer does not publish prices for its add-ons, so a quote must be requested from sales.
facts.quote: AppsFlyer does not publish add-on pricing. You need to contact sales for a quote

facts.fact: The Airbridge blog's table estimates AppsFlyer Growth cost at $700 per month for 10,000 monthly attributed conversions, before add-ons.
The Airbridge blog's table estimates AppsFlyer Growth cost at $3,500 per month for 50,000 monthly attributed conversions.
facts.quote: | 50,000 | $3,500/mo | Teams at this volume often negotiate Enterprise pricing |

facts.fact: Airbridge's own Core Plan starts at $40 or more per month and includes 500K data points per month, per Airbridge's page.
facts.quote: Airbridge's Core Plan bills by data points at $40+/mo with 500K included

facts.fact: Airbridge's own Core Plan charges $0.0001 per data point beyond the included usage.
Airbridge's own page states that a month with 1M data points on the Core Plan costs $90.
facts.quote: a month with 1M data points costs $40 + (500K × $0.0001) = $90

facts.fact: Airbridge's own Core Plan offers a 30-day free trial with no data point limits and no annual contract.
facts.quote: 30-day free trial, no data point limits

facts.fact: Airbridge's own page states that its Core Plan has no annual contract and can be cancelled at any time.
Airbridge's own page states that tracking-link clicks and ad impressions are not counted as data points.
facts.quote: Tracking-link clicks and ad impressions do not count.

facts.fact: Airbridge's own page claims its Core Plan includes Predictive LTV with a 180-day window without an add-on.
facts.quote: Predictive LTV (180 days), and audience sync to ad networks without an add-on.

facts.fact: The Airbridge blog post was published on October 14, 2026 and last updated the same day.
